# FLUX 3 multi-reference, prepared

**Workflow:** [`flux3/flux3-multi-reference-prep.json`](../flux3/flux3-multi-reference-prep.json)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Family | `flux3` |
| Nodes | 15 |
| Links | 16 |
| Paid API calls per run | **1** |

---

Three references normalised to a sensible size, checked in order on a contact strip, then sent to FLUX 3 Image together — so nothing is rejected for size and nothing arrives in the wrong slot.

**Scale Image to Total Pixels** (core) brings each reference to **1.0 MP** with lanczos. The API refuses a reference over 16 MP and one under 256 × 256, and a phone photo uploaded at full size just makes the call slower. Raise `megapixels` for image 1 if the output should keep more of its detail — its frame sets the output's.

**Stitch Images** (core) lays the three out left to right in socket order, labelled nothing but order itself: the leftmost is *image 1*. Check it before you spend — the prompt refers to the references by number, so a swapped Load Image is a different request.

**Image Comparer** sets the room (image 1) against the result.

Connect more references and more sockets appear on the FLUX 3 node, up to 10; extend the stitch chain to match.

### Needs
[rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy). **Manager → Install Missing Custom Nodes** finds it if the graph loads with red nodes.

## The prompt lives in one node

The **Shared Prompt** node feeds every FLUX 3 `prompt` in this graph, so there is one
place to edit it. It emits a plain string, **not** a list, so each node it feeds still runs once.
